symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each integer being multiplied.
symbols.quote: Integer multiplication in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time, the main theorem of this wiki, is that a fixed deterministic machine multiplies $n$-bit integers within this bound, where $n$ is the number of bits in each input integer and $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the fixed saving exponent in the logarithmic factor.

symbols.name: saving exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed constant $2^{-182}$ giving the power saving in the logarithmic factor.
symbols.quote: Integer multiplication in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time, the main theorem of this wiki, is that a fixed deterministic machine multiplies $n$-bit integers within this bound, where $n$ is the number of bits in each input integer and $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the fixed saving exponent in the logarithmic factor.

symbols.name: stored bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits on which the tape procedures act.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored bit volume, $u$ the width of each address field, $d$ the number of equal-width address chunks in which one bit position is selected, and $\tau,\lambda'<1$ fixed exponents.

symbols.name: address field width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two address fields being interchanged.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored bit volume, $u$ the width of each address field, $d$ the number of equal-width address chunks in which one bit position is selected, and $\tau,\lambda'<1$ fixed exponents.

symbols.name: chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of equal-width address chunks in which one bit position is selected.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored bit volume, $u$ the width of each address field, $d$ the number of equal-width address chunks in which one bit position is selected, and $\tau,\lambda'<1$ fixed exponents.

symbols.name: interchange exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 in the interchange cost $O(Vu^\tau)$.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored bit volume, $u$ the width of each address field, $d$ the number of equal-width address chunks in which one bit position is selected, and $\tau,\lambda'<1$ fixed exponents.

symbols.name: butterfly exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below 1 in the butterfly layer cost $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the stored bit volume, $u$ the width of each address field, $d$ the number of equal-width address chunks in which one bit position is selected, and $\tau,\lambda'<1$ fixed exponents.

symbols.name: role count
symbols.meaning: The number of roles of each fixed linear network.
symbols.quote: Let $W$ be the number of roles of each network, $s$ the total number of its smaller calls and $m$ the dimension of the space whose subspaces label its gates, so that $s<Wm$.

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls made by each network.
symbols.quote: Let $W$ be the number of roles of each network, $s$ the total number of its smaller calls and $m$ the dimension of the space whose subspaces label its gates, so that $s<Wm$.

symbols.name: subspace dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the space whose subspaces label the network's gates.
symbols.quote: Let $W$ be the number of roles of each network, $s$ the total number of its smaller calls and $m$ the dimension of the space whose subspaces label its gates, so that $s<Wm$.

symbols.name: recursion level
symbols.meaning: The level of the recursion, so that the field width is $m^k$.
symbols.quote: Let $k$ be the recursion level and $F_k$ the time divided by volume at level $k$, so that $u=m^k$.

symbols.name: cost per unit volume
symbols.meaning: The time divided by volume at recursion level $k$.
symbols.quote: Let $k$ be the recursion level and $F_k$ the time divided by volume at level $k$, so that $u=m^k$.

relations.quote: The machine performs its address moves by [Fast interchange of address fields](fast-address-interchange.md).
It performs its butterfly layers by [Fast simultaneous butterfly layers](fast-butterfly-layers.md).
The machine computes its convolution by [Convolution with retained transform order and cancelled permutations](ring-convolution-retained-order.md).
It recovers its coefficients by [Fixed-point precision and exact recovery](fixed-point-precision.md).
It disproves the [n log n optimality conjecture](nlogn-conjecture.md).
The machine places the coefficient list by the [Chinese-remainder map to prime cyclic axes](crt-address-map.md) onto prime cyclic axes.

derivations.quote: Let $W$ be the number of roles of each network, $s$ the total number of its smaller calls and $m$ the dimension of the space whose subspaces label its gates, so that $s<Wm$. Let $k$ be the recursion level and $F_k$ the time divided by volume at level $k$, so that $u=m^k$. A call at level $k$ makes $s$ calls at level $k-1$, each on a stream of volume $V/W$, so $F_k\le (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1)$ with $F_0=O(1)$. Since $s/W<m$, choose a rational $\tau\in(0,1)$ with $s/W<m^\tau$. Then the sum of $(s/W)^j$ over $j\le k$ is $O(m^{k\tau})$, so $F_k=O(u^\tau)$ and the interchange costs $O(Vu^\tau)$.
